meta.title: Impact
meta.description: Live, anonymized figures on SafeSiso's reach across Northern Ghana — girls reached, conversations handled, and verified safe space partners active.

hero.title: What SafeSiso has actually done
hero.intro: Figures on this page come straight from the running service. They are aggregated counts and nothing else — no conversation content, and no detail that could identify a girl, ever appears here.

points.title: Counts, never content
points.body: Every figure here is an aggregate count. No message a girl has ever sent appears on this page, in any form.

points.title: Anonymized at the source
points.body: The numbers are produced from data that never contained a name, an age, a school or a location, because SafeSiso does not collect those.

points.title: Nothing re-identifiable
points.body: Figures are reported at programme and regional level only. Nothing published here can be traced back to an individual girl or an individual conversation.

points.title: The same figures go to our funders
points.body: These are the same aggregated statistics reported monthly to UNFPA Ghana and PPAG. There is no separate, rosier set of numbers.

closing.heading: Behind every number
closing.body: Each of these counts is a girl who had a question and nowhere safe to ask it.
